title: China Outbuilds America 230-to-1. Saronic Has a Plan
summary: All nine auto-generated English transcript chunks were reviewed as untrusted lead material. They advance Saronic founder and host views on autonomous maritime systems, US and Chinese shipbuilding, defense procurement, and a future shipyard. Existing registered primary evidence supports only the already-maintained broad defense-demand and product-procurement context; no video-only assertion changed a maintained conclusion or trading state.
